purpose: Proposed minimal, text-only anatomy RAG reference shortlist; not an executable deployment manifest.
selection_scope: 17 existing website vascular labels, including artery segments and non-coronary great vessels; not 17 distinct coronary arteries.
licence_conditions: Use only the article authors’ text covered by the stated licence; exclude separately credited third-party material unless separately cleared.
Retain author(s), title, publication details, DOI/source link, copyright notice when supplied, CC BY 4.0 label and licence link.
Mark extraction/formatting changes and identify AI-generated explanations as generated paraphrases rather than author quotations or endorsement.
Exclude images, figures, figure captions and supplementary files from the starter upload. Keep tables out until separately reviewed.
Upload each unique selected source/extract once; map its source ID to multiple vessel labels instead of duplicating the text.
Retain section locators and original reference markers in extracted prose. Do not promote articles merely cited by a review into independently reviewed sources.
Allow cross-vessel retrieval when relevant; selected structure should guide ranking, not force irrelevant or unsupported answers.
For unsupported branch-specific diagnosis, exact segment boundaries, treatment or prognosis, state that the curated material does not establish the answer.
This register does not alter the existing knowledge base, grant scientific approval or perform any upload or paid API call.

vessels.label: Right Coronary Artery (Proximal)
vessels.starter_coverage: RCA origin/course; proximal occlusion and right-ventricular infarction; ECG and imaging.
vessels.limitation: Whole-vessel and territory-level diagnostic coverage; segment boundaries require a consistent local definition.

vessels.label: Right Coronary Artery (Middle)
vessels.starter_coverage: RCA course and branches, affected downstream myocardium, shared infarction investigations.
vessels.limitation: No separate universal mid-RCA syndrome or ECG pattern is established.

vessels.label: Right Coronary Artery (Distal)
vessels.starter_coverage: Distal branching/dominance and shared coronary infarction context.
vessels.limitation: Do not assume every distal RCA obstruction produces right-ventricular infarction.

vessels.label: Posterior Descending Artery
vessels.starter_coverage: PDA course/origin and dominance; shared RCA/inferior-infarction clinical context.
vessels.limitation: The selected pair is not a dedicated isolated-PDA diagnostic algorithm.

vessels.label: Left Coronary Artery
vessels.starter_coverage: Left-main anatomy, obstruction, clinical significance and diagnostic modalities.
vessels.limitation: Interpret this marker as the left-main trunk, not the entire left coronary arterial tree.

vessels.label: Left Anterior Descending (Proximal)
vessels.starter_coverage: LAD origin/course and supply, with general coronary artery disease and diagnosis.
vessels.limitation: Anatomy plus general clinical context; not a proximal-LAD-specific diagnostic algorithm.

vessels.label: Left Anterior Descending (Mid)
vessels.starter_coverage: LAD course/branches and shared coronary artery disease and diagnostic explanations.
vessels.limitation: Exact segment boundaries and lesion-level ECG predictions are outside this starter coverage.

vessels.label: Left Anterior Descending (Apical)
vessels.starter_coverage: LAD course toward the apex and shared coronary ischaemia/infarction diagnosis.
vessels.limitation: Apical is the website marker: do not automatically equate it to every standardized distal LAD definition.

vessels.label: Left Diagonal D1
vessels.starter_coverage: Diagonal branch anatomy/territory and clinical context of impaired diagonal flow.
vessels.limitation: R5 is observational anterior-STEMI/main-diagonal evidence, not universal isolated-D1 prognosis.

vessels.label: Left Diagonal D2
vessels.starter_coverage: Diagonal-family anatomy and consequences/assessment of impaired diagonal flow.
vessels.limitation: Shared branch-family evidence only; no dedicated isolated-D2 diagnostic/prognostic coverage was established.

vessels.label: Left Circumflex Artery
vessels.starter_coverage: LCx course, branches, dominance, occlusion, clinical presentation and imaging.
vessels.limitation: Retain the limitations of standard ECG detection discussed by the review.

vessels.label: Right Marginal Artery
vessels.starter_coverage: Right-ventricular marginal supply, infarction after occlusion, and RV infarction investigations.
vessels.limitation: Acute marginal branch; shared RV-infarction assessment rather than a unique branch-only algorithm.

vessels.label: Right Conus Artery
vessels.starter_coverage: Conus/RV-outflow-tract supply plus a documented occlusion and diagnostic case.
vessels.limitation: R7 is a case report; do not generalize its presentation, absolute prognosis or treatment.

vessels.label: Left Marginal Artery
vessels.starter_coverage: Obtuse-marginal-family anatomy and LCx/lateral-territory clinical and diagnostic context.
vessels.limitation: Do not silently rename the generic marker OM1/OM2; no branch-order-specific diagnostic rule is claimed.

vessels.label: Ascending Aorta
vessels.starter_coverage: Ascending-aortic anatomy, aneurysm/dissection, thrombus/embolism and CT/echo assessment.
vessels.limitation: Aortic thrombus may embolize without fully occluding the aorta; aortic valve stenosis is different.

vessels.label: Superior Vena Cava
vessels.starter_coverage: SVC anatomy, compression/thrombosis, SVC syndrome and diagnostic investigations.
vessels.limitation: Use anatomy/obstruction/diagnostic concepts, not the older treatment recommendations.

vessels.label: Coronary Sinus
vessels.starter_coverage: Coronary venous drainage, sinus thrombosis, consequences and diagnostic imaging.
vessels.limitation: Venous outflow obstruction is different from coronary arterial inflow obstruction.
